class.name: DisDetonationPdu
class.brief_description: Detonation PDU (type 3): a munition detonated or impacted.
class.description: A Detonation PDU reports that a munition detonated or hit something at [member DisWarfarePdu.location_ecef]. It is 104 bytes plus 16 bytes per variable parameter and has protocol family 2 (Warfare); most fields are inherited from [DisWarfarePdu]. Use the same [member DisWarfarePdu.event_id], munition descriptor and target as the [DisFirePdu] it belongs to. [member DisWarfarePdu.munition_id] is the exploding entity ID here, and [member DisWarfarePdu.velocity] is the munition's velocity at detonation (ECEF, m/s). [member detonation_result] says what the munition hit; [member location_in_entity] gives the impact point in the target's own frame. Variable parameters (for example articulation records) are kept as raw 16-byte records in [member variable_parameters].

method.name: decode
method.description: Parses [param bytes] as a Detonation PDU and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method DisPdu.get_last_error] if [param bytes] is not a valid Detonation PDU (header shorter than 12 bytes, wrong PDU type, protocol version outside 1-7, length field larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code], or fewer than 104 bytes). A length field of 0 is replaced by the datagram size. Bytes after the last known field, up to the length field, are kept in [member DisPduBase.trailing_bytes]. The variable parameter count in the PDU must fit inside the length, otherwise the PDU is rejected.

members.member: What the munition did, as a SISO-REF-010 "Detonation Result" code (8-bit). The most common values are the [enum DetonationResult] constants; other codes are allowed.
Location of the detonation relative to the target entity, as a [Vector3] in metres in the target's body coordinates (32-bit floats on the wire). Meaningful when the munition hit an entity.
The 16-bit padding field that follows the variable parameter count. Normally 0; kept so that decoded PDUs encode to the same bytes.

Variable parameter records as an [Array] of [PackedByteArray], each exactly 16 bytes, kept raw. At most 255 entries are allowed; [method DisPduBase.encode] returns an empty array for more. Entries of any other size are skipped by [method DisPduBase.encode] and an error is printed.

constants.constant: Detonation result 1: the munition hit an entity.
Detonation result 2: the munition detonated close to an entity.
Detonation result 3: the munition hit the ground.
Detonation result 4: the munition detonated close to the ground.
Detonation result 5: a detonation without further detail.
Detonation result 6: no detonation, or the munition was a dud.
Detonation result 17: the munition hit an aircraft or other airborne target.
Detonation result 24: the munition hit water.
Detonation result 25: the munition burst in the air.
